Netra X specialization.

Diabetic retinopathy is silent until it is late.

It is a leading cause of preventable blindness, yet rural and underserved clinics rarely have an eye specialist. Netra X turns one fundus photograph into a severity grade, lesion outlines and a heatmap that shows its reasoning.

Precautions

For patients

  • Get a retina exam every year, even if your vision feels fine. Early damage causes no symptoms.
  • Keep blood sugar, blood pressure and cholesterol in the targets your doctor sets.
  • Take medicines as prescribed and avoid smoking, which speeds up eye damage.
  • Examine both eyes. A screening result for one eye says nothing about the other.
  • Follow the referral date. Do not wait for pain or blurring before booking.

For clinics using Netra X

  • It is a screening aid, not a diagnosis. An eye doctor confirms every referral.
  • Retake flagged photos. Blurred, dark or glared images give unreliable grades.
  • Refer when unsure. Moderate or worse, or low image quality, always goes to a specialist.
  • Protect patient data. Take consent, encrypt images and share nothing without permission.
  • Check performance on your cameras and across patient groups, and review missed cases regularly.
See a doctor the same day for sudden vision loss, a dark curtain across your sight, a burst of new floaters or flashes of light.
NETRA X is a prototype for AI-assisted retinal microvasculature diagnostics. All values are simulated.
